subject: planner: simplify predicate with the static prune (#62507)
summary: Reviewed diff vs parent only for planner changes. The change applies `ApplyPredicateSimplification` to `DataSource.AllConds`/`PushedDownConds` during static partition pruning (after `PushDownNot`), and adds an early `Conds2TableDual` return when the filter becomes constant false/NULL. This is semantics-preserving for WHERE (empty result) and uses existing plan-cache guards (`MaybeOverOptimized4PlanCache`). No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, transaction/session, or privilege/visibility issues found in the touched planner logic.
